subject: GO TO statement
notes: kb/Work PB397, corrected by kb/Work PB2610. A Format 1 GO TO followed by an IMPERATIVE statement in the same consecutive sequence of imperative statements (within a sentence's statements, or within one phrase of another statement) is refused (COBOL2967). A following CONDITIONAL statement (14.5.1: a conditional phrase written without its explicit scope terminator - an IF or EVALUATE with no END-, an ADD with ON SIZE ERROR and no END-ADD, a SEARCH, a READ AT END) ends that sequence, so the GO TO before it is accepted; a delimited scope statement is imperative (14.5.3.2) and is refused after the GO TO. Before PB2610 every following statement was refused, which rejected legal source at every edition. The Format 2 DEPENDING GO TO is not constrained; the 1985 target-less GO TO is that edition's Format 1 and is covered. One existing golden (85/pb413_go_to_out_of_inline_perform) wrote the GO TO beside a following DISPLAY on purpose and was corrected to put the GO TO in an IF phrase.
